trips.note: Connects at the Squamish government dock with the Union Steamships boat from Vancouver (Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays). Overnight to Quesnel, with stages on to Prince George, Wells and Barkerville.
Leaves Quesnel Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays; overnight to the Squamish government dock for the Union Steamships boat to Vancouver.
